//: Frontend-only Vercel config for the split architecture (API on Render). To use: replace the repo's vercel.json with this file, then set the API host in the rewrite below AND in public/index.html <meta name="ceram-api">. Until then keep the default vercel.json (monolith on Vercel).

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://res.cloudinary.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.cerampro.com https://api.cloudinary.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
